eyebrow: Where does the yield come from?

code:
Protocol A -- "inflationary yield"
  Advertised APY: 150%
  Source: 100% newly minted governance tokens
  Real revenue this year:      $50,000
  Tokens emitted this year:    $15,000,000

  -> yield backed almost entirely by new issuance
caption: Only "real" as long as the token's price survives $15M/year of new supply.

code:
Protocol B -- "real yield"
  Advertised APY: 8%
  Source: 100% trading fees (USDC/ETH), no new minting
  Real revenue this year:        $2,400,000
  Paid out to stakers:           $2,400,000

  -> yield fully backed by actual usage-driven revenue
caption: Smaller number, but every dollar paid already exists as revenue.
